facts.fact: eMarketer projects 68% of the US population, about 234 million people, will use CTV in 2024.
facts.quote: In 2024, [68% of the US population](https://forecasts-na1.emarketer.com/584b26021403070290f93a3a/5d9671494945300bf4895bf9)—around 234 million people—will be using CTV.

facts.fact: eMarketer expects CTV users in the US to grow to 250 million, or 71% of the population, by 2028.
facts.quote: By 2028, this number is expected to grow to 250 million users, 71% of the population.

facts.fact: eMarketer forecasts US CTV ad spending to rise from $28.75 billion USD in 2024 to $44.32 billion USD in 2028.
facts.quote: ad spending projected to jump from $28.75 billion USD in 2024 to $44.32 billion USD in 2028.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that the CPM for premium CTV inventory typically falls within a range of $15 to $30 USD.
facts.quote: the cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) for premium [CTV inventory](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/connected-tv-inventory) typically falls within a reasonable range of $15 to $30 USD.

facts.fact: The vendor states that advertisers can target Warner Brothers Discovery across HGTV, HBO Max, Pluto, Tubi, Samsung Plus, and more, beyond Disney and NBC.
facts.quote: Beyond Disney and NBC, advertisers can target Warner Brothers Discovery across HGTV, HBO Max, Pluto, Tubi, Samsung Plus, and more.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, advertisers must engage with the publishers they plan to invest in through its DSP to make informed CTV campaign decisions.
facts.quote: Advertisers must engage with the publishers they plan to invest in through our DSP to make informed campaign decisions.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that historically B2B clients have had little direct interaction with the CTV publishers it works with.
facts.quote: Historically, B2B clients haven’t had much direct interaction with the publishers we work with.
